title: Secondary Actions
description: Additional outcomes beyond a primary verdict/disposition, for a genuinely compound ruling in the external-review pattern. Shared by review-arbiter-verdict.schema.json and external-review-ledger.schema.json so a compound ruling has one shape wherever it's recorded. Always OPTIONAL on the referencing property — omit when there are none. This file defines the SHAPE only; the compound-ruling SEMANTICS live in the review-arbiter agent + flow-external-review.

type.$comment: Documented 2-value SUBSET of external-review-ledger.schema.json's disposition enum — the compounding-eligibility rule (which dispositions may take a secondary action) is owned by the review-arbiter agent + flow-external-review. $ref is not used here precisely because the secondary-action domain is narrower than the full disposition set.
